Co-founder of Crescendo Equity Partners | alma_mater = [[Cornell University]] | spouse = {{marriage|[[Peter Thiel]]|2017}} }} '''Charles Matthew Danzeisen'''{{cite news |last1=전 |first1=수영 |title=산은·기은, 선진 벤처캐피탈과 손잡고 '글로벌파트너십펀드' 결성 |url=https://www.polinews.co.kr/news/articleView.html?idxno=220160 |date=25 November 2024}} (born 1977) is an American financier and investor. He was vice president of [[BlackRock]] before becoming portfolio manager at [[Thiel Capital]] in 2008. He is active in Asia and Asia-Pacific. Danzeisen is co-founder of [[Peter Thiel#Crescendo Equity Partners|Crescendo Equity Partners]]. In 2017, he married [[Peter Thiel]]. ==Early life== In 2023, ''[[List of LGBTQ periodicals#United States|EDGE Media Network]]'' reported Danzeisen's age to be 56.{{cite news |title=Late Model/Influencer Jeff Thomas Attended BF Peter Thiel's New Year Party, Angering Thiel's Husband |url=https://story.edgemedianetwork.com/story.php?324299 |work=EDGE Media Network |date=6 April 2023 |language=en-us}} In 2026, ''[[Blick]]'' reported his age to be 49.{{cite news |last1=Hotz |first1=Michael |title=Donald Trumps Vordenker wohnt jetzt in Argentinien |url=https://www.blick.ch/wirtschaft/peter-thiel-zuegelt-nach-argentinien-donald-trumps-stiller-vordenker-verlaesst-die-usa-id21991796.html |work=Blick |date=31 May 2026 |language=de-CH}} ''[[Briefly.co.za|Briefly News]]'' reports that he was born "between the late 1960s and early 1970s".{{cite news |last1=Adeaga |first1=Favour |title=Meet Matt Danzeisen: The husband of PayPal co-founder Peter Thiel - Director Profile - Endole |url=https://open.endole.co.uk/insight/people/25344783-charles-matthew-danzeisen |website=open.endole.co.uk |access-date=21 November 2025}} Danzeisen graduated from the Cornell University School of Hotel Administration in 1999.{{cite book |author1=Cornell University School of Hotel Administration Alumni Affairs Office |title=Directory of Alumni of the Cornell University School of Hotel Administration |url=https://books.google.com/books?id=aWUsAQAAMAAJ |publisher=Cornell University, School of Hotel Administration, Alumni Affairs Office |page=1013|date=31 October 2021 |language=en}} He holds a degree in finance with a minor in economics from Cornell University and is also a CFA charterholder.{{cite web |title=Team |url=https://www.haymaker.com/team |website=www.haymaker.com |access-date=27 November 2025}}{{cite web |title=Matthew Danzeisen: Positions, Relations and Network - MarketScreener |url=https://www.marketscreener.com/insider/MATTHEW-DANZEISEN-A1R4QN/ |website=www.marketscreener.com |access-date=27 November 2025}} ==Career== [[File:Sanae Takaichi received a courtesy call from Peter Thiel on March 5, 2026.jpg|thumb|Danzeisen (left), with Peter Thiel, Japanese prime minister [[Sanae Takaichi]] and [[Kei Satō (politician)|deputy chief cabinet secretary Kei Satō]], March 5, 2026]] He served as an investment banker at [[Bank of America|Bank of America Securities Asia Ltd.]] from 2000 to 2001 and vice president at [[BlackRock]] from 2002 to 2008. When he and Thiel started dating around 2007, he was based in New York, where Thiel had a house.{{cite book |last1=Chafkin |first1=Max |title=The Contrarian: Peter Thiel and Silicon Valley's Pursuit of Power |date=21 September 2021 |publisher=Bloomsbury Publishing |isbn=978-1-5266-4554-8 |page=127 |url=https://books.google.com/books?id=5bc_EAAAQBAJ&pg=PA127 |language=en}} ''[[Gawker]]'' reported in 2008 that he worked for BlackRock Securities. In 2007, Thiel considered moving Clarium (Thiel Capital's predecessor) to New York, but discarded the plan. Instead, Danzeisen left his job at BlackRock and joined [[Clarium Capital]] and Thiel Capital in 2008.{{cite news |last1=Thomas |first1=Owen |title=Forbes declares Peter Thiel "single," which may be news to his boyfriend |url=https://www.gawkerarchives.com/377641/forbes-declares-peter-thiel-single-which-may-be-news-to-his-boyfriend |work=Gawker |date=9 April 2008a |language=en}}{{cite news |last1=Thomas |first1=Owen |title=Peter Thiel to move his hedge fund to New York |url=https://valleywag.com/345811/peter-thiel-to-move-his-hedge-fund-to-new-york |work=Gawker |date=16 January 2008b |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180719181806/https://valleywag.com/345811/peter-thiel-to-move-his-hedge-fund-to-new-york |archive-date=19 July 2018}}{{cite web |title=Matthew Danzeisen: Positions, Relations and Network - MarketScreener |url=https://www.marketscreener.com/insider/MATTHEW-DANZEISEN-A1R4QN/ |website=www.marketscreener.com |access-date=5 November 2025 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250902031529/https://www.marketscreener.com/insider/MATTHEW-DANZEISEN-A1R4QN/ |archive-date=2 September 2025}} His official position at Thiel Capital is portfolio manager and head of private investments, focusing on the U.S. and Asia.{{cite news |last1=Redrup |first1=Yolanda|title=Major US tech investors arrive on Australian mission |url=https://www.afr.com/technology/major-us-tech-investors-arrive-on-australian-mission-20160127-gmervb |work=Australian Financial Review |date=1 February 2016 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20230410051145/https://www.afr.com/technology/major-us-tech-investors-arrive-on-australian-mission-20160127-gmervb |archive-date=10 April 2023 |language=en}} According to ''[[Handelsblatt]]'', in practice, he co-manages Thiel Capital with Thiel.{{cite news |last1=Drost |first1=Frank Matthias |last2=Schier |first2=Susanne |last3=Kapalschinski |first3=Christoph |last4=Demling |first4=Alexander |title=Peter Thiels neue Investment-Sympathie für Europa |url=https://www.handelsblatt.com/technik/it-internet/valar-ventures-peter-thiels-neue-investment-sympathie-fuer-europa/26795334.html?ticket=ST-3329902-6x1vNhv1Do04BbRiSHbA-ap4 |work=www.handelsblatt.com |date=14 January 2021 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210114155447/https://www.handelsblatt.com/technik/it-internet/valar-ventures-peter-thiels-neue-investment-sympathie-fuer-europa/26795334.html?ticket=ST-3329902-6x1vNhv1Do04BbRiSHbA-ap4 |archive-date=14 January 2021}} His key role for the firm and in the Silicon Valley investment industry are exemplified by various trips to Asia and Asia-Pacific. On trips in 2014 and subsequently, he both represented Thiel Capital and headed up Thiel Capital-led business groupings in their meetings with political and business leaders.{{cite web |title=Heavyweight US Investors Meet Victorian Startups |url=https://www.premier.vic.gov.au/heavyweight-us-investors-meet-victorian-startups/ |website=www.premier.vic.gov.au |access-date=4 December 2025 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180512030058/https://www.premier.vic.gov.au/heavyweight-us-investors-meet-victorian-startups/ |archive-date=12 May 2018 |language=en-au}}{{cite news |last1=Shapiro |first1=Jonathan |last2=McDuling |first2=John |title=Peter Thiel's secret Aussie super play |url=https://www.afr.com/companies/financial-services/peter-thiels-secret-aussie-super-play-20170410-gvhqi0 |work=Australian Financial Review |date=11 April 2017 |archive-url=https://archive.today/20240301230951/https://www.afr.com/companies/financial-services/peter-thiels-secret-aussie-super-play-20170410-gvhqi0 |archive-date=1 March 2024 |language=en}} In 2018, he visited [[Tashkent]], Uzbekistan—with a delegation consisting of representatives from Thiel Capital, Thundermark Capital, and several Silicon Valley- and South Korean-based companies affiliated with them—to discuss the development of IT exports with the country's Ministry of Finance. On that occasion, ''Anhor'' (also known as ''anhor.uz''{{cite web |title=Media: Uzbekistan |url=https://caspiana.omeka.fas.harvard.edu/exhibits/show/media/uzbekistan |publisher=Program on Central Asia · Davis Center for Russian and Eurasian Studies · Harvard University |access-date=22 November 2025}}) reported that, "Matt Danzeisen is a portfolio manager at the international investment fund Thiel Capital [...] He specializes in private investments and is responsible for the financial services sector at the company. Matt Danzeisen oversees equity investments in the US, Europe, and Australia. He manages two funds in Japan and South Korea."{{cite news |title=В Ташкент приезжает менеджер американского венчурного фонда |url=https://anhor.uz/it-science/v-tashkent-priezzhaet-menedzher-amerikanskogo-venchurnogo-fonda/ |work=Anhor.uz |date=28 May 2018 |language=ru-RU}}{{cite news |title=Manager of the Thiel Capital Foundation to visit Uzbekistan |url=https://www.uzdaily.uz/en/manager-of-the-thiel-capital-foundation-to-visit-uzbekistan/ |work=UzDaily.uz |date=25 May 2018 |language=en}}{{cite news |title=Thiel Capital to assist MUIC in development of IT export |url=https://www.uzreport.news/technology/thiel-capital-to-assist-muic-in-development-of-it-export |work=UzReport.news |date=25 May 2018 |language=en}}{{cite news |last1=Dolukhanov |first1=Fikret |title=Thiel Capital to help Uzbekistan attract investments to IT sector |url=https://www.trend.az/business/it/2908516.html |work=Trend.Az |date=25 May 2018 |language=en}} ''[[Uzreport TV|Uzreport]]'' describes him as "a specialist in attracting private investment". Thiel entrusted operations of Valar to what his biographer Max Chafkin called "a team of loyalists", led by Danzeisen (then principal at Clarium), [[PayPal Mafia|Andrew McCormack]], and James Fitzgerald. These three sat on the board of Thiel's companies in New Zealand, Second Star Limited, and Silverarc Advisors.{{sfn|Chafkin|2021|p=209}}{{cite news |title=Billionaire Facebook Investor Peter Thiel Pours Money Into His "Utopia," New Zealand |url=https://www.businessinsider.com/peter-thiel-new-zealand-2011-1 |work=Business Insider |date=14 January 2011}} In 2021, through Second Star Limited (which the couple co-owned), Danzeisen and Thiel applied for a permit to build a bunker-like mansion near [[Lake Wanaka]]; their application was declined.{{cite news |last1=Cook |first1=Marjorie |title=Thiel's Wanaka mansion plan declined |url=https://www.nzherald.co.nz/nz/billionaire-peter-thiels-wanaka-mansion-plan-declined-another-recommended/HRCHQZRUX6LA2RIQCG6LSL6TWA/ |work=NZ Herald |date=4 May 2022 |language=en-NZ}}{{cite news |last1=Gibson |first1=Anne |title=Exclusive: US billionaire Peter Thiel proposes luxury lodge |url=https://www.nzherald.co.nz/business/exclusive-us-billionaire-peter-thiel-proposes-luxury-lodge-near-wanaka/W3S35ON5FRKTMLQKEBYFCS3Z5U/ |work=NZ Herald |date=1 September 2021 |language=en-NZ}}{{cite news |last1=McClure |first1=Tess |title=Billionaire Peter Thiel refused consent for sprawling lodge in New Zealand |url=https://www.theguardian.com/technology/2022/aug/18/peter-thiel-refused-consent-for-sprawling-lodge-in-new-zealand-local-council |work=The Guardian |date=18 August 2022}} Later, Thiel wound down his business interests in New Zealand and Valar's operations in the country ceased. There have been debates about Thiel's intentions regarding New Zealand: Chafkin doubts that he was serious with the country from the start (hence why Danzeisen and others were tasked with leading Valar without an official team).{{cite news |last1=Cooke |first1=Henry |title=Peter Thiel a 'great ambassador' for NZ - despite keeping citizenship secret |url=https://www.stuff.co.nz/national/politics/94207497/peter-thiel-was-in-nz-for-just-12-days-before-becoming-a-citizen |work=www.stuff.co.nz |date=30 June 2017}}{{cite news |last1=Foster |first1=Liam |title=Peter Thiel's Exit from New Zealand: A Decade of Investments, Controversy, and Unmet Expectations |url=https://b2bnews.co.nz/news/peter-thiels-exit-from-new-zealand-a-decade-of-investments-controversy-and-unmet-expectations/ |work=b2bnews.co.nz |date=25 February 2025 |language=en-NZ}}{{sfn|Chafkin|2021|p=209}}{{cite news |last1=Novak |first1=Matt |title=Peter Thiel Described as 'Great Ambassador' For New Zealand Despite Secret Citizenship |url=https://gizmodo.com/peter-thiel-described-as-great-ambassador-for-new-zeala-1796507953 |work=Gizmodo |date=29 June 2017}} In 2022, during the time Thiel was trying to obtain Maltese citizenship, Thiel, Danzeisen, and others set up a company named EUM Holdings Melite Ltd in [[Malta]]. ''[[The New York Times]]'' remarks that the process was "a series of Byzantine events", which involved Coru, a Mexican financial-advice startup with a London parent. Entities controlled by Thiel and Danzeisen were among Coru’s largest investors, but after the company failed to secure new funding in late 2020, it entered administration. Thiel, Danzeisen, and several other Coru investors then created EUM, which bought Coru’s shares for about $100,000. Maltese government records list Thiel and Danzeisen as residing at a Valletta apartment, but when a ''Times'' reporter visited, a tourist staying there via a short-term rental answered the door. The ''Times'' also found an Airbnb listing for a "2BR oceanfront executive penthouse" using the same address.{{cite news |last1=Vella |first1=Matthew |title=Billionaire Republican donor Peter Thiel reported to be seeking Maltese passport |url=https://www.maltatoday.com.mt/news/national/119253/billionaire_republican_donor_peter_thiel_reported_to_be_seeking_maltese_pasport |work=MaltaToday.com.mt |date=15 October 2022 |language=en}}{{cite news |last1=Mac |first1=Ryan |last2=Scheck |first2=Justin |title=Peter Thiel, Major U.S. Political Donor, Is Said to Pursue Maltese Citizenship |url=https://www.nytimes.com/2022/10/15/technology/peter-thiel-malta-citizenship.html |date=15 October 2022 |archive-url=https://archive.today/20221028030341/https://www.nytimes.com/2022/10/15/technology/peter-thiel-malta-citizenship.html |archive-date=28 October 2022}} According to ''The New York Times'', lawyers and immigration experts say Maltese citizenship offers Thiel no clear tax benefit, though wealthy individuals from countries like Saudi Arabia, Russia, and China often seek it for EU access and as a safeguard against political or social instability at home. ==Personal life== Danzeisen married Peter Thiel, whom he has described as his best friend,{{cite news |last1=Bohn |first1=Ricardo |title=PayPal Gründer: Schockierende Todesnachricht - Selbstmord? |url=https://newsflash24.de/blaulicht/paypal-gruender-peter-thiels-liebhaber-stuerzt-tragisch-in-den-tod/ |work=Newsflash24 |date=6 April 2023 |language=de}} in 2017.{{cite book |last1=Kleine-Gunk |first1=Bernd |last2=Sorgner |first2=Stefan Lorenz |title=Homo ex machina: Der Mensch von morgen - Ein differenziert,er Blick auf den Transhumanismus |date=21 June 2023 |publisher=Goldmann Verlag |isbn=978-3-641-28981-2 |page=1994 |url=https://books.google.com/books?id=DBWcEAAAQBAJ&pg=PA1994 |language=de}} The wedding happened in [[Vienna, Austria]], on Thiel's 50th birthday (October 2017), when he was reported to have proposed to Danzeisen. The guests had only been informed that they would attend a birthday party but were surprised at the announcement that it would be a wedding ceremony.{{cite news |last1=Karnak |first1=Chris |title=PayPal-Gründer Peter Thiel: Hochzeitsantrag in Wien? {{!}} GGG.at |url=https://www.ggg.at/2017/10/30/paypal-gruender-peter-thiel-hochzeitsantrag-in-wien/ |date=30 October 2017 |language=de}}{{sfn|Gellman|2023}}{{cite web|url =https://www.axios.com/peter-thiel-got-married-over-the-weekend-1513306233-29abae6d-fa70-4939-b15e-0d0042986700.html|title =Peter Thiel got married over the weekend|website =Axios|first1 =Dan|last1 =Primack|first2 =Mike|last2 =Allen|date =16 October 2017|access-date =1 September 2018|archive-date =2 September 2018|archive-url =https://web.archive.org/web/20180902012028/https://www.axios.com/peter-thiel-got-married-over-the-weekend-1513306233-29abae6d-fa70-4939-b15e-0d0042986700.html|url-status =live}} Despite media reports coming from the U.S. about the wedding, Austrian media at the time doubted that they married in Austria, because contemporary Austrian law did not allow same-sex marriage (same-sex marriage only [[Same-sex marriage in Austria|became legal in Austria on 1 January 2019]]).{{cite web |last1=Österreich |first1=Außenministerium der Republik |title=Registered partnerships |url=https://www.bmeia.gv.at/en/austrian-embassy-to-lithuania/service-for-citizens/civil-status-family/registered-partnerships |website=www.bmeia.gv.at |access-date=4 December 2025|archive-url=https://archive.today/20251204032851/https://www.bmeia.gv.at/en/austrian-embassy-to-lithuania/service-for-citizens/civil-status-family/registered-partnerships|archive-date=4 December 2025}} In 2017, after Thiel began to support Trump, Danzeisen also declared (among the couple's circles) his support for the Republican candidate, although reportedly with a much more reserved attitude than his partner.{{cite news |last1=Mac |first1=Ryan |title=Peter Thiel Has Been Hedging His Bet On Donald Trump |url=https://www.buzzfeednews.com/article/ryanmac/peter-thiel-and-donald-trump |work=BuzzFeed News |date=7 August 2017 |language=en}} In 2023, in an interview with the ''[[Atlantic (magazine)|Atlantic]]'', Thiel noted that Danzeisen had tried to dissuade him from donating money to Republicans.{{cite web |last1=Gellman |first1=Barton |title=Peter Thiel Is Taking a Break From Democracy |url=https://www.theatlantic.com/politics/archive/2023/11/peter-thiel-2024-election-politics-investing-life-views/675946/ |website=The Atlantic |access-date=1 January 2024 |archive-url=https://archive.today/20231230131758/https://www.theatlantic.com/politics/archive/2023/11/peter-thiel-2024-election-politics-investing-life-views/675946/ |archive-date=30 December 2023 |language=en |date=9 November 2023}} Danzeisen is known for being private. By the time he married Thiel, little was known about him beyond his position at Thiel Capital, his moderate support for Trump, and his speech on [[fintech]] at a 2017 conference in Japan.{{cite news |title=Peter Thiel sells majority of his Facebook shares |url=https://www.nzherald.co.nz/business/peter-thiel-sells-majority-of-his-facebook-shares/4PGE4SNSG5QCQ4W522TDBK2KGM/ |work=NZ Herald |date=22 November 2017 |language=en-NZ}}{{cite news |title=PayPal Billionaire, Trump Supporter Peter Thiel Secretly Gets Married to Longtime Boyfriend {{!}} EDGE United States |url=https://www.edgemedianetwork.com/story/250440 |work=EDGE Media Network |date=17 October 2017 |language=en}} ''Mediaflux'' noted in 2022 that while it was known that Danzeisen was prominent in business and had invested in fintech, the details of his portfolio were not disclosed. When the [[Enhanced Games]] was launched in Las Vegas in 2025, Danzeisen participated together with a delegation from Thiel Capital and a security detail, but they were so discreet that a ''[[Wired (magazine)|Wired]]'' reporter did not realize that they were there until being told afterwards.{{cite magazine |last1=Katwala |first1=Amit |date=10 June 2025 |title=The Definitive, Insane, Swimsuit-Bursting Story of the Steroid Olympics |url=https://www.wired.com/story/enhanced-games-freestyle-record-las-vegas-steroids/ |url-access=subscription |url-status=live |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250815233933/https://www.wired.com/story/enhanced-games-freestyle-record-las-vegas-steroids/ |archive-date=15 August 2025 |magazine=[[Wired (magazine)|Wired]]}} According to Max Chafkin, the couple tends to keep distance from each other in public and are rarely seen standing together or holding hands, with Thiel treating Danzeisen like his other employees. According to a 2022 ''[[Financial Times]]'' article, as Thiel had a fascination with challenging conventional thinking, family dinners the couple shared with their daughter typically involved "three and a half hours debating the strangest things" like "if there was an alien invasion, how would you reach diplomatic common ground?"{{cite news |last1=Waters |first1=Richard |last2=Fedor |first2=Lauren |title=Peter Thiel, the contrarian tech investor turns to politics |url=https://www.ft.com/content/d2259cd1-704d-4cd4-814d-994c4e754695 |work=www.ft.com |date=11 February 2022 |archive-url=https://archive.today/20220212033756/https://www.ft.com/content/d2259cd1-704d-4cd4-814d-994c4e754695 |archive-date=12 February 2022}} The couple are parents of up to four children, although sources differ.{{cite news |title=Tech billionaire Peter Thiel says he only allows his children 1.5 hours of screen time a week |url=https://www.yahoo.com/news/tech-billionaire-peter-thiel-says-110403774.html |access-date=6 June 2025 |work=Yahoo News |date=30 June 2024}}{{cite news |last1=Wooldridge |first1=Adrian |title=Today's Eugenics Is Much More Dangerous |url=https://www.bloomberg.com/opinion/articles/2025-08-22/eugenics-is-more-dangerous-with-musk-and-noor-siddiqui |date=22 August 2025}} In 2022, the couple made news when they arrived in Romania, where they were followed by paparazzi.{{cite news |last1=Ongweso Jr |first1=Edward |title=An Alleged Billionaire Halloween Party at Dracula's Castle Sent Romania Into a Frenzy |url=https://www.vice.com/en/article/an-alleged-billionaire-halloween-party-at-draculas-castle-sent-romania-into-a-frenzy/ |work=VICE |date=1 November 2022}}{{cite news |title=Matt Danzeisen, la plimbare pe munte, în Brașov. Soțul lui Peter Thiel se relaxează după petrecerea "monstru" ce a avut loc aseară, la Castelul Bran / VIDEO |url=https://spynews.ro/paparazzi/matt-danzeisen-la-plimbare-pe-munte-in-brasov-sotul-lui-petre-thiel-se-relaxeaza-dupa-petrecerea-monstru-ce-a-avut-loc-aseara-la-castelul-bran-video-292225.html |work=SPYNEWS.RO |date=30 October 2022 |language=RO}}{{cite news |last1=Pană |first1=Mălina |title=Peter Thiel, fondatorul PayPal și partenerul lui, miliardarul Matt Danzeisen |url=https://mediaflux.ro/peter-thiel-fondatorul-paypal-si-partenerul-lui-miliardarul-matt-danzeisen/ |work=MediaFLUX.ro |date=29 October 2022 |language=ro}}{{cite news |last1=Pană |first1=Mălina |title=Exclusiv paparazzi: Eveniment ULTRA-SECRET în România: Cel mai bogat om din lume, Elon Musk, Angelina Jolie și alți miliardari ai planetei, petrecere de Halloween la Bran. Peter Thiel, fondatorul PayPal, a aterizat deja azi-noapte pe aeroportul Otopeni |url=https://mediaflux.ro/exclusiv-paparazzi-eveniment-ultra-secret-cel-mai-bogat-om-din-lume-elon-musk-angelina-jolie-si-alti-miliardari-ai-planetei-petrecere-de-halloween-la-bran-peter-thiel-fondatorul-paypal-a-ateri/ |work=MediaFLUX.ro |date=29 October 2022b |language=ro}} They attended the Halloween party at [[Bran Castle]]{{cite news |last1=Pană |first1=Mălina |title=Peter Thiel, fondatorul PayPal și partenerul lui, miliardarul Matt Danzeisen |url=https://mediaflux.ro/peter-thiel-fondatorul-paypal-si-partenerul-lui-miliardarul-matt-danzeisen/ |work=MediaFLUX.ro |date=29 October 2022c |language=ro}}{{cite news |last1=Moisoiu |first1=de Catalina Andreea |title=Peter Thiel, fondatorul PayPal, a luat prânzul în Brașov. Cum a fost surprins miliardarul? Toți s-au mirat |url=https://www.capital.ro/peter-thiel-fondatorul-paypal-a-luat-pranzul-in-brasov-cum-a-fost-surprins-miliardarul-toti-s-au-mirat.html |work=Capital |date=30 October 2022 |language=Romanian}} and were seen walking to a restaurant in central [[Brașov]].{{cite news |last1=Matei |first1=Daniel |title=Peter Thiel, la masă la un restaurant din centrul Brașovului. Cât a plătit miliardarul pentru meniu |url=https://www.gandul.ro/diverse/showbiz/peter-thiel-la-masa-la-un-restaurant-din-centrul-brasovului-cat-a-platit-miliardarul-pentru-meniu-19865198 |work=Gândul |date=30 October 2022 |language=ro-RO}} ''Veridica'' reports that Thiel and Danzeisen actually organized the party, which was also attended by [[Ken Howery]].{{cite news |last1=Manu |first1=Caesar |title=Să râdem cu Musk și Bran (și cu-ai noștri Gușă și Șoșoacă) |url=https://www.veridica.ro/opinii/sa-radem-cu-musk-si-bran-si-cu-ai-nostri-gusa-si-sosoaca |work=www.veridica.ro |date=1 November 2022 |language=ro}} [[Sam Altman]] has also served with Danzeisen on the board of the Bridgetown companies.{{cite web |title=PROSPECTUS FILED PURSUANT TO RULE 424(B)(4) REGISTRATION NO. 333-251860 $260,000,000 Bridgetown 2 Holdings Limited |url=https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1831236/000121390021004685/f424b40121_bridgetown2.htm |website=www.sec.gov |access-date=22 November 2025}}{{cite web |title=Form S-1 REGISTRATION STATEMENT UNDER THE SECURITIES ACT OF 1933 Bridgetown 3 Holdings Limited |url=https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1844028/000121390021012944/filename1.htm |access-date=22 November 2025 |website=www.sec.gov}} Like Danzeisen, he was mentioned as a friend in Thiel's circle by ''[[BuzzFeed News]]'' in 2017. He has thanked Danzeisen for contributing to his essays on development of AI and China.{{cite news |last1=김 |first1=창수 |title=샘 올트만: AI가 집값을 반값으로 낮추는 미래에 대한 예측 |url=https://www.beyondx.ai/modeun/ |work=비욘드엑스 |date=13 November 2024 |language=ko}}{{cite web |title=China |url=https://blog.samaltman.com/china |website=Sam Altman |access-date=22 November 2025}} It was at a birthday party which Thiel organized for Danzeisen in 2023 that Thiel warned Altman that half of Altman's subordinates at [[OpenAI]], who had supposedly been "programmed" by [[Eliezer Yudkowsky]], wanted to remove Altman.{{cite book |last1=Hagey |first1=Keach |title=The Optimist: Sam Altman, OpenAI, and the Race to Invent the Future |date=20 May 2025a |publisher=W. W. Norton & Company |isbn=978-1-324-07597-4 |page=i |url=https://books.google.com/books?id=Dqk9EQAAQBAJ&pg=PT1 |access-date=22 November 2025 |language=en}} Altman was fired on 17 November of that year, but rehired in the same month, and reinstated as CEO in March 2024.{{cite news |last1=Paul |first1=Kari |title=OpenAI reinstates CEO Sam Altman to board after firing and rehiring |url=https://www.theguardian.com/technology/2024/mar/08/openai-sam-altman-reinstated |work=The Guardian |date=9 March 2024}}{{cite news |last1=Hagey |first1=Keach |title=Exclusive {{!}} The Secrets and Misdirection Behind Sam Altman's Firing From OpenAI |url=https://www.wsj.com/tech/ai/the-real-story-behind-sam-altman-firing-from-openai-efd51a5d |work=The Wall Street Journal |date=28 March 2025b |archive-url=https://archive.today/20251006003842/https://www.wsj.com/tech/ai/the-real-story-behind-sam-altman-firing-from-openai-efd51a5d |archive-date=6 October 2025}} ==See also== * [[Jeff Thomas (model)]] ==References== {{reflist}} ==External links== *[https://www.haymaker.com/team Matt Danzeisen's profile at Haymaker Ventures] {{DEFAULTSORT:Danzeisen, Matt}} [[Category:American investors]] [[Category:American financiers]] [[Category:Peter Thiel]] [[Category:Living people]] [[Category:Cornell University alumni]] [[Category:American LGBTQ businesspeople]] [[Category:Year of birth missing (living people)]] [[Category:21st-century American businesspeople]] [[Category:21st-century American LGBTQ people]] [[Category:American company founders]]
extract: Charles Matthew Danzeisen (born 1977) is an American financier and investor. He was vice president of BlackRock before becoming portfolio manager at Thiel Capital in 2008. He is active in Asia and Asia-Pacific. Danzeisen is co-founder of Crescendo Equity Partners. In 2017, he married Peter Thiel.
